652:t_1:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It seems the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ transferred to the opposite side of the galactic center from us.」

652:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Did we get in touch with them?」

652:t_1:6.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Apparently they could only communicate for a short time.」

652:t_1:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Are they under attack from $$ミケーネ$$ and the $$御使い$$s too?」

652:t_1:8.en:
$$アスラン$$
「When they contacted us, they said they were being attacked by $$バジュラ$$... specifically the kind controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

652:t_1:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s $$バジュラ$$...」

652:t_1:10.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「They're an ultra-long-range emigrant fleet, like the $$フロンティア船団$$ and the $$マクロス７船団$$... Apparently they're near the galactic center too.」

652:t_1:11.en:
$$フォウ$$
「But to attack the $$クォーター$$ out of nowhere like that...」

652:t_1:12.en:
$$ファ$$
「Does that mean they know our every move in this vast universe...?」

652:t_1:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We don't know that much. But we'll have to keep a close eye on the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s movements.」

652:t_1:14.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's strange... We managed to join hands even with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, yet humans are still fighting each other...」

652:t_1:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「I heard something from $$シェリル$$ once.」

652:t_1:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「She said the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ isn't quite normal... They actively encourage 《$$インプラント$$》 technology, for one thing.」

652:t_1:17.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Their ethics and morals may be completely different from ours...」

652:t_1:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ランカ$$ and the others tried to communicate with the $$バジュラ$$ through the Fold Waves in their songs...」

652:t_1:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is controlling them through some means.」

652:t_1:20.en:
$$キラ$$
「Coexistence and domination are different... If they keep doing things that way, the fighting will never end...」

652:t_1:21.en:
$$シン$$
「It's all right, $$キラ$$. They have $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$... and $$バサラ$$ with them.」

652:t_1:22.en:
$$アスラン$$
「The power of their songs should put an end to the war with the $$バジュラ$$ and the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s ambitions.」

652:t_1:23.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah... I believe we'll all meet again at the center of the galaxy.」

652:t_1:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-yes! I'm sorry, Big Sis... I mean, $$ノリコ$$!」

652:t_1:32.en:
$$セイミー$$
「Come on, get to work! This is an all-out war for humanity, so everyone who can move is helping with maintenance!」

652:t_1:33.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Even so, you're pushing us too hard... Since we got here, it's been one $$宇宙怪獣$$ or $$インベーダー#pilot$$ attack after another. We haven't had a moment to rest.」

652:t_1:34.en:
$$くらら$$
「Don't complain. We're all just as tired.」

652:t_1:35.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「And even as we speak, the countdown to Earth's final day keeps ticking.」

652:t_1:36.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Before then, we must wipe out the $$バアル$$, and defeat the evil gods and the $$御使い$$s as well.」

652:t_1:37.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Just having you two stop flirting makes things feel a whole lot more serious...」

652:t_1:38.en:
$$葵$$
「So, $$ノノ$$... If you slack off, I'll crack the whip in $$ラルク$$'s place.」

652:t_1:39.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's just what $$ノノ$$ wants, $$葵$$! With hard work and guts, $$ノノ$$ will get it done too!」

652:t_1:40.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is spinning her wheels...」

652:t_1:41.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「She does seem worried about $$ラルク$$...」

652:t_1:42.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are both $$バスターマシン$$ pilots, even if they come from different worlds... They're pushing themselves too hard with all that hard work and guts.」

652:t_1:43.en:
$$くらら$$
「Hold on a second, $$カズミ$$!」

652:t_1:44.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I get $$ノノ$$, but does hard work and guts really describe $$ラルク$$...?」

652:t_1:46.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But someone without hard work or guts couldn't be an ace or come up with that $$雷王星$$ drop, could they?」

652:t_1:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just what I'd expect of the Rose Queen... You see the Princess clearly, without being misled by needless preconceptions.」

652:t_1:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... Hard work and guts take different forms for everyone.」

652:t_1:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Some people are at it all year round with simulations and special training, like $n. Others keep it to themselves, like $$ラルク$$.」

652:t_1:51.en:
$n
「I knew. She... often joined my special training, pretending she had no choice.」

652:t_1:52.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Exactly. And afterward, she'd give me advice, though she'd act like I owed her and throw in plenty of snide remarks.」

652:t_1:53.en:
$$マリ$$
「So basically, every girl called 'Princess' is cut from the same cloth, nya~.」

652:t_1:57.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone knows a side of Big Sis that $$ノノ$$ doesn't...」

652:t_1:58.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The Princess changed without you noticing.」

652:t_1:59.en:
$$チコ$$
「She's not the only one who's changed, though.」

652:t_1:60.en:
$$チコ$$
「And the ones who changed the Princess were you, $$ノノ$$... you and $c.」

652:t_1:62.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right. And of course, $$ノリコ$$'s presence played a part too.」

652:t_1:63.en:
$n
「So their hard work and guts influenced $$ラルク$$ too.」

652:t_1:64.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But Big Sis... said she hated that kind of thing...」

652:t_1:65.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Hard work and guts... No one likes pain or hardship.」

652:t_1:66.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But, $$ノノ$$... Both $$ノリコ$$ and $$ラルク$$ know.」

652:t_1:67.en:
$$カズミ$$
「They know you can't accomplish anything without hard work and guts.」

652:t_1:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ is worried... Big Sis seems... as though something is driving her...」

652:t_1:71.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... $$ノノ$$ feels that if this keeps up, someday... Big Sis will stop treating her own life as something precious...」

652:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$ too...」

652:t_1:77.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any strange ideas.」

652:t_1:79.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There comes a time for everyone when they have to do that...」

652:t_1:80.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But don't give up looking for another way until the very end.」

652:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I thought you might be feeling trapped over what happened with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$...」

652:t_1:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a comrade die either... especially someone younger than me.」
